column2: Although Shri Shrimad Gour Govinda Swami Maharaj was situated in Hyderabad
his heart was ever restless to fulfill the long-cherished desire of his Spiritual Master, to plant the seed of Krishna consciousness in the sacred land of Utkal.
He was mostly concerned for the spiritual awakening of the village people, and anxious to serve his beloved Gopaal.
All those pure desires were the root cause of his inspiration to open a centre and spread the teachings of Shrila Prabhupada in Odisha.
We can see this from his diary as follows
Oh Lord... as the Supersoul, You know the inner thoughts of this servant.
You are the real desire tree.
Whenever and whatever this servant desired, you fulfilled it; but now in this place, why is this servant not able to achieve divine love and transcendental bliss through service?

This servant gave up everything and came forward to take sannyasa deeksha for the development of his dear worshipable Gopaal's place, to serve the devotees present there, as well as to preach in Odisha.
Oh Lord... by Your causeless mercy, in Vrindavan, this servant met Shrila Prabhupada, in the form of Shri Guru.
In fact, His Divine Grace is the most magnanimous incarnation and also like a desire tree.
His Divine Grace gave shelter to this servant at his lotus feet and also offered him sannyasa deeksha.
You know how this servant went to Odisha, and had to return from there.
But this servant's real place is in Odisha, and that You have spoken through Shrila Prabhupada's lotus mouth.
Still, You are testing this servant in a very strange way by creating such a strange situation, and breaking the strong determination of this servant.
Because of that, sometimes this servant becomes hopeless and feels whether you really do not want it?
Otherwise, why is this not happening?
Shri Shri Ishopanishad Hindi book printing work is completed, so please create a favourable environment in Odisha.
Let this servant be engaged in preaching Shri Shri Guru and Gauranga's message in Odisha.
For this service, please shower divine love, spiritual energy, and strong determination power.
If an ISKCON centre can be established in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, then this servant has a desire to open a rural preaching centre at Gopaal's place.
For this purpose, a confirmation from Ghanashyama Prabhu has already been received.
If You so desire, everything will be settled.
For that, this servant cannot force You, rather he simply begs for Your causeless mercy.
May You shower a drop of that mercy.
Oh my Lord, Gopaal... please shower Your mercy.
May this servant achieve Krishna prema along with proper devotee association, well-wishers and companions.
May this servant achieve success in the service of Shri Shri Guru and Gauranga.
Haribol
